title: The T1150A cancer mutant of the protein lysine dimethyltransferase NSD2 can introduce H3K36 trimethylation.
authors: Khella, Mina S; Schnee, Philipp; Weirich, Sara; Bui, Tan; Brohm, Alexander; Bashtrykov, Pavel; Pleiss, Jurgen; Jeltsch, Albert
one_liner_zh: 该文研究NSD2/NSD1组蛋白甲基转移酶突变体对H3K36甲基化产物特异性的影响，虽用MD模拟解析酶活性位点机制，但对象为蛋白-组蛋白底物而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Protein lysine methyltransferases (PKMTs) play essential roles in gene expression regulation and cancer development. Somatic mutations in PKMTs are frequently observed in cancer cells. In biochemical experiments, we show here that the NSD1 mutations Y1971C, R2017Q, and R2017L observed mostly in solid cancers are catalytically inactive suggesting that NSD1 acts as a tumor suppressor gene in these tumors. In contrast, the frequently observed T1150A in NSD2 and its T2029A counterpart in NSD1, both observed in leukemia, are hyperactive and introduce up to three methyl groups in H3K36 in biochemical and cellular assays, while wildtype NSD2 and NSD1 only introduce up to two methyl groups. In Molecular Dynamics simulations, we determined key mechanistic and structural features controlling the product specificity of this class of enzymes. Simulations with NSD2 revealed that H3K36me3 formation is possible due to an enlarged active site pocket of T1150A and loss of direct contacts of T1150 to critical residues which regulate the product specificity of NSD2. Bioinformatic analyses of published data suggested that the generation of H3K36me3 by NSD2 T1150A could alter gene regulation by antagonizing H3K27me3 finally leading to the upregulation of oncogenes.
abstract_zh: 蛋白赖氨酸甲基转移酶（PKMTs）在基因表达调控和癌症发展中发挥重要作用。癌细胞中频繁观察到PKMTs的体细胞突变。在生化实验中，我们展示了主要在实体癌中观察到的NSD1突变Y1971C、R2017Q和R2017L具有催化失活性，表明NSD1在这些肿瘤中作为肿瘤抑制基因发挥作用。相反，在白血病中观察到的NSD2的T1150A突变及其在NSD1中的对应突变T2029A则表现出超活性，在生化和细胞实验中能向H3K36引入多达三个甲基基团，而野生型NSD2和NSD1仅能引入最多两个甲基基团。在分子动力学模拟中，我们确定了控制这类酶产物特异性的关键机制和结构特征。针对NSD2的模拟揭示，H3K36me3的形成可能归因于T1150A突变导致活性位点口袋扩大，以及T1150与调控NSD2产物特异性的关键残基之间直接接触的丧失。对已发表数据的生物信息学分析提示，NSD2 T1150A产生H3K36me3可能通过拮抗H3K27me3来改变基因调控，最终导致癌基因的上调。
